changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Execution') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[Execution]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [Total] [int] NOT NULL, [Processed] [int] NOT NULL, [Error] [int] NOT NULL, [StartedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, [Fields] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [ErrorMessage] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Method] [varchar](7) NULL, [Route] [varchar](250) NULL, [ProcessingStartedOn] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecution] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'State') BEGIN alter table api.Execution add [State] int NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_Execution_State] DEFAULT ((1)) END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'MarkedForProcessing') BEGIN alter table api.Execution add [MarkedForProcessing] bit NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_Execution_MarkedForProcessing] DEFAULT ((0)) END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'ErrorMessage') BEGIN update [api].[Execution] set [ErrorMessage] = left(ErrorMessage, 2000); alter table api.Execution alter column [ErrorMessage] nvarchar(2500); END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'ApplicationID') BEGIN alter table api.Execution add [ApplicationID] nvarchar(200) END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'Id') BEGIN alter table api.Execution add Id int identity not null END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_Execution_CompletedOn_StartedOn') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_Api_Execution_CompletedOn_StartedOn ON api.Execution (CompletedOn, StartedOn) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_Execution_Route_Include') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_Api_Execution_Route_Include ON api.Execution ([Route]) INCLUDE (CompletedOn, ExecutionID) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_Execution_ResourceID') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_Api_Execution_ResourceID ON api.Execution ( ResourceID ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_ApiExecution') BEGIN create clustered index CIX_ApiExecution ON api.Execution ( Id asc ) END
